tools.name: record_browser_session
tools.title: Record Browser Session
tools.description: Open the remote browser, navigate to start_url, begin recording, and save the recording into the current Playground room when returned. If the user did not provide a URL, ask for one before calling this tool.

start_url.title: Start URL
start_url.description: URL to open. Bare hostnames such as google.com are prefixed with https://.

recording_name_hint.title: Recording Name Hint
recording_name_hint.description: Provide a concise semantic name derived from the user's request, such as Google homepage or customer login flow. This is saved with the recording for later discovery.

tools.name: find_browser_recordings
tools.title: Find Browser Recordings
tools.description: Inspect browser recordings saved in the current Playground room and return compact summaries containing filenames, metadata, URLs, hosts, and recorded steps. Use this before replay when the user did not provide an exact recording filename. Compare the returned candidates, tell the user which recording appears closest, and ask for confirmation. After confirmation, call replay_browser_recording with the exact recording_file.

query.title: Recording Description
query.description: Natural-language description of the desired recording, such as google.com or checkout login flow. Leave empty to list room recordings.

max_candidates.title: Maximum Candidates
max_candidates.description: Maximum recording summaries to return. Defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 50.

tools.name: replay_browser_recording
tools.title: Replay Browser Recording
tools.description: Open the remote browser and replay a confirmed recording from the current Playground room. Prefer an exact recording_file selected from find_browser_recordings. If only a natural-language description is available, call find_browser_recordings first, explain the closest candidates, and ask the user to confirm before opening this tool.

recording_name_hint.title: Room Recording Name Hint
recording_name_hint.description: Natural-language description of the Playground room recording, such as google.com or login flow.

project_id.title: Fallback Project ID
project_id.description: Optional accessible app to search as a fallback.

start_url.title: Start URL
start_url.description: Optional URL override to open before replaying the recording.
